brief:
A European study documents declining support for Israel across five Western nations, alongside growing pro-Palestinian sentiment particularly among young people, the Shehab Wire reported. The research tracked shifts in public opinion across the surveyed countries, identifying a marked generational divide in attitudes toward the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

Youth populations in the examined Western nations showed notably stronger backing for Palestinian causes compared to older demographics, according to the findings.
dek: A European study documents declining support for Israel across five Western nations, alongside growing pro-Palestinian sentiment particularly among young people, the Shehab Wire reported.
title: Western support for Israel declines as solidarity with Palestinians rises
